record.question: Identify the false statement regarding two bid and two-stage bidding systems:
options: In the first stage of a two-stage bidding process, the bidders may be invited to submit technical proposals along with indicative prices to facilitate the finalisation of specifications
Two-stage bidding may be adopted when it is not feasible to formulate detailed specifications without obtaining technical inputs from bidders
Under a two bid system, technical and financial bids are submited simultaneously in separate sealed covers
In a two-stage bidding, the bidder is expected to carry out a detailed survey or investigation
